instruction: Use Abaqus via the Command Line Interface (CLI) to complete the following task. 1. Part module: - Create a 3D Deformable Solid part using Extrusion. - Create a straight rectangular bar with length 100 mm along the global X-axis. - The cross-section should be a 10 mm x 10 mm square in the Y-Z plane. - The final geometry should occupy: - X = 0 to 100 mm - Y = 0 to 10 mm - Z = 0 to 10 mm 2. Property module: - Create a material named Steel. - Define the elastic material properties: - Young's modulus E = 210000 MPa - Poisson's ratio nu = 0.3 - Create a Solid Homogeneous section using material Steel. - Assign the section to the entire bar. 3. Assembly module: - Create one dependent instance of the bar. 4. Step module: - Create a Static, General step named Step-Load. - Use the Initial step as the previous step. 5. Load module: - Apply an Encastre boundary condition to the end face at X = 0. - Apply a tensile surface traction to the end face at X = 100 mm. - Use Surface Traction, General. - Set the traction magnitude to 10 MPa. - Set the traction direction to the global positive X direction. - The traction is equivalent to a total tensile force of 1000 N over the 10 mm x 10 mm end face. 6. Mesh module: - Apply a global seed size of 5 mm. - Assign element type C3D8R. - Generate the mesh. 7. Job module: - Create a job named Job-Tension. - Submit the job for analysis. - Wait for the analysis to complete successfully. 8. Visualization module: - Open the output database. - Display the Mises stress contour. - Query the U1 displacement at the node located at the center of the free end face: - X = 100 mm - Y = 5 mm - Z = 5 mm 9. Save: - Save the Abaqus model database as: C:\Users\user\Desktop\Job-Tension.cae - Ensure that the output database is generated as: C:\Users\user\Desktop\Job-Tension.odb [Software] To start Abaqus/CAE, run `C:\SIMULIA\CAE\2025LE\win_b64\resources\install\le\launcher.bat cae` (adjust path to your install). Before starting the work, Abaqus command-line jobs should be launched through `C:\SIMULIA\Commands\abaqus.bat`.
